description: Source code implementing SHA-1 compression functions, collision detection, and context management for SHA-1 hashing.

methods.name: SHA1DCInit
methods.description: Initializes SHA-1 context with default values.

methods.name: SHA1DCSetSafeHash
methods.description: Sets whether to perform safe hash operations.

methods.name: SHA1DCSetUseUBC
methods.description: Enables or disables UBC (Universal Bit Check) in collision detection.

methods.name: SHA1DCSetDetectReducedRoundCollision
methods.description: Enables or disables reduced round collision detection.

methods.name: SHA1DCSetCallback
methods.description: Sets callback function for collision blocks.

methods.name: SHA1DCUpdate
methods.description: Updates SHA-1 context with new data.

methods.name: SHA1DCFinal
methods.description: Finalizes the hash and outputs the digest.
